sections.heading: What we store
body: Your account details (name, email, and a securely hashed password handled by our login provider, Neon Auth).
The text of the notes you turn into sets, the summaries and flashcards made from them, and your study progress.
Basic usage counts (how many AI actions you used today) so we can keep Kodigo free and fair for everyone.

sections.heading: What we don't store
body: PDF and PowerPoint files are read on your phone. Only the extracted text is sent to us; the files themselves never leave your device.
Photos of your notes are shrunk on your phone, sent once to read the text, then discarded. We never save them.

sections.heading: AI providers
body: To make summaries and flashcards, the text of your notes is sent to third-party AI services: Google (Gemini), Groq, and OpenRouter.
These services' free tiers may use the data they receive to improve their models. Please don't upload sensitive personal information such as ID numbers, medical records, or passwords.

sections.heading: Security
body: Your data is only reachable through our server after you log in, and every request is limited to your own data. Bot protection is provided by Cloudflare Turnstile.

sections.heading: Deleting your data
body: You can delete your account anytime in Profile → Delete my account. This removes your account, sets, cards and progress.

sections.heading: Using Kodigo
body: Kodigo is a free study tool. Use it to review your own notes and school materials.
Don't use it to break the law, harass others, or overload the service (for example with automated requests).

sections.heading: AI can be wrong
body: Summaries, flashcards and answers are generated by AI and can contain mistakes. Always double-check with your notes, teacher, or textbook.

sections.heading: Your content
body: You keep ownership of your notes. You're responsible for making sure you're allowed to upload them.

sections.heading: Fair use limits
body: To keep Kodigo free, there are daily limits on AI features. Accounts that abuse the service may have AI features paused.

sections.heading: No warranty
body: Kodigo is provided as is, without guarantees of availability. We may change or discontinue features at any time.
